error.message: Rider "x" rolls its own attack, so its critDamage would never be used. Remove it, or pass plain damage dice instead.
Rider "x" rolls its own attack and sets "happens"; only a damage rider may not happen.
"lr" reads a granted modifier, but it is a list of several attacks, with no single attack check to re-derive. Declare each attack as its own rider, or scope the grant with `to`.

Rider "rr" rerolls on any miss and reads a granted modifier. An any-miss rider resolves after every declared attack, so it would see the grants in force at the end of the turn instead of right after the miss. Use onFirstMiss (on: "first-miss"), which resolves directly after the attack that missed.

Rider "rr" rerolls on any miss and applies a condition's grants. An any-miss rider resolves after every declared attack, so it would see the grants in force at the end of the turn instead of right after the miss. Use onFirstMiss (on: "first-miss"), which resolves directly after the attack that missed.
